utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s right — Saturday morning by the community hall. I’ll bring something small that needs fixing, and thanks again for sorting it out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — that helps a lot. If you hear what they’re still short on, I can pass it along to folks nearby.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything. Much appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, just tell me what supplies we already have, and I’ll start a list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I’m a bit scattered too—I don’t have the full supply list on me yet. I can check what’s been gathered and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem—just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep the list going.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning still works for me. I can help with the fence and the loose step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Leo—thanks. Bring your gloves if you can, and I’ll get you set up on the fence and step repair.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll bring my gloves and be there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sam — we’re gathering small broken items this Saturday morning by the community hall. If you’ve got something that needs fixing, just bring it along and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — I’ll spread the word and bring by any small repairs folks mention.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate you spreading the word. See you Saturday morning by the community hall, and I’ll help sort the repairs out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, then: the repair drive is actually on, and you’re organizing it, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — the repair drive is on, and I’m happy to help spread the word. If you want, I can also connect anyone interested with Hana and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — can you confirm the pickup time and what’s being hauled first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t seen any screwdrivers yet, but I’ll keep looking and let you know if any turn up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Just let me know the time and where we’re meeting, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’re welcome, Eli — let’s meet at the repair drive table by the community center at 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for helping with the repair drive, Opal. I’ll keep an ear out for anyone around the neighborhood who needs a hand getting things fixed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep the drop-off spot and item list organized, and let me know if you hear of anyone who needs specific repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll pass along any repair requests I hear while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That still works for me — thanks. We can tackle the fence and the loose step Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to what needs doing on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll show you both spots then — the fence panel and the loose step. Thanks again for helping out Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school pickup, but I’ll need to leave before dinner. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye—it's starting in the late afternoon, so after school pickup should work fine. Even an hour would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that should work for me. Just let me know the exact start time and where to meet, and I’ll stop by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll bring up the repair drive with a few neighbors and see who’s available. If you’ve got any details handy, send them my way and I’ll repeat them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the top priorities are Mrs. Alvarez’s leaky sink and the broken front step at the community hall. I’ll send you the full list so you can share it with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll pass along Mrs. Alvarez’s sink and the community hall step, and let folks know to keep an eye out for the full list. Thanks, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Quinn, I’m bringing the lamp by later today for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mina—thank you! I’ll send the exact drop-off time and spot as soon as I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—please let me know as soon as you have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — once I have the pickup time and the first items, I can plan my route properly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got my wrench set and can help sort the tools by job—just point me to the pickup time and where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — once I know the pickup time and where the tools need to go first, I can line up the route and haul plan.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — have you seen if they need anything specific at the repair drive? I could help look for tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need the pickup time and what’s being hauled first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, sorry — I don’t have the pickup time yet. I’ll ask and let you know what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Kira—if you can help, we could still use a drill and maybe someone to keep the tools sorted by job.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right? And what time do you need the drill and tools sorted by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on—if you can swing by this afternoon, that’d be perfect for the drill and sorting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll keep an eye out for screwdrivers and extension cords, and I’ll let you know if I spot any.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — that would really help. I can pass along any leads and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’ll keep my eyes open and pass along anything useful I hear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—school items, mostly small fixes. If you have a list of what’s broken, I can help sort what can be repaired first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — I’ll ask around and get a list together. Then we can figure out what to tackle first at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help sort the repairs by priority.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll bring it by later today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Mina. I’ll be around and ready to help when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — I’ll stop by later today with the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. I’ll tell a few neighbors and see if anyone wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—count me in, and I can bring a wrench set if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great—yeah, a wrench set would really help. I’ll let folks know and keep an eye out for anyone else who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great—I'll send over the list so we can sort the most urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send the list over and I’ll share it with everyone so we can get the repairs moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll send it over shortly so everyone can see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re collecting broken items for the repair drive this Saturday morning by the community hall. If you have anything small that needs fixing, bring it along and I’ll help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re just trying to get a few things fixed up around the block, nothing fancy. If you can help spread the word, that'd mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and keep it simple. I’ll also check in with Mrs. Alvarez and the hall today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me, as long as I know the drop-off spot ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — the drop-off spot is the community center side entrance. I’ll be there at 6:30 and can take requests then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks — community center side entrance at 6:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be really helpful. I’m happy to pass it along if you find out what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet — I’ve only heard we’re still figuring out the biggest needs first. If you get the list, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m on it, Opal — I’ll send the list shortly with the needed items, drop-off spot, and top priorities so you can organize everything بسهولة.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Rosa — once it comes through, I’ll map out who’s bringing what and where to drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll get it to you soon, and I’ll include the first repair priorities so we can tackle the urgent fixes right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive — I’m a bit foggy, but I can bring something small that needs fixing on Saturday morning by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — bring whatever needs fixing, and I’ll help sort it out Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll bring something small and see you Saturday morning by the community hall.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
